question: Explain the components of internal control that the auditor considers when understanding the entity under SA 315.
sources: SA 315 Identifying and Assessing the Risks of Material Misstatement

points.label: Control environment
points.description: The attitude and actions of those charged with governance and management about internal control, such as integrity, ethical values and commitment to competence.
points.basis: SA 315, components of internal control: control environment

points.label: Entity's risk assessment process
points.description: How the entity identifies business risks that affect financial reporting, judges their significance and decides how to deal with them.
points.basis: SA 315, components of internal control: risk assessment process

points.label: Information system and communication
points.description: The procedures and records used to start, record, process and report transactions, and how roles and matters about financial reporting are communicated.
points.basis: SA 315, components of internal control: information system and communication

points.label: Control activities
points.description: Policies and procedures that make sure management's directions are carried out, such as authorisation, reconciliations, physical controls and segregation of duties.
points.basis: SA 315, components of internal control: control activities

points.label: Monitoring of controls
points.description: The process of checking over time whether controls are working as intended and fixing weaknesses.
points.basis: SA 315, components of internal control: monitoring of controls
